paragraphs.text: Oros (OR-ohz) ), the Avenger , is a male primeval dragon on Dominaria in an alternate timeline.

Oros is a male primeval dragon from Dominaria that was seen during the Temporal crisis of Dominaria . He is a large ruddy-scaled dragon, with black horns and a coppery jaw and neck frills. He wears silvery jewelry around his neck, horns, arm, and wing claw.
The four other alternate timeline primeval dragons are Intet , Numot , Teneb and Vorosh .
